body.p: A man and a girl were going through the mountains. There, at one river they made their camp. Then the brother went [DCh]: Later in the story it becomes clear that the girl is the man's sister. off. When the brother had gone, his sister was taken away by a tramp. The brother went and came home. The sister, whom he had left at home, is not at home. The brother searched for his sister, he went looking onto the shore, he saw her traces on the sand. The person quickly took his gun, he went downstream along the river. He saw [that] they are going by boat. The person [DCh]: The form "dÊ¼awradÊ¼aratta" is unclear. ran upstream beneath(?) them, he started shouting. Running he said to his girl [=sister]: "Drill [a hole] into the boat!" The girl, what the brother said, she drilled the boat with an awl. Their boat started to fill up. They landed at the shore. "The boat started to fill up", the tramps said, "smear [the hole] with larch resin". The girl started to smear it with larch resin, she hung up her coat at a tree, she herself ran to her brother. The tramo said: "Old woman, hey, come on, come here", he shouted to her coat. The tramp went off, [only] her coat is hanging [on the tree]; he started to search for the woman. The girl's brother said: "Tramp, well, that's your wife!" The tramp ran off, the person chased the tramp, he shot, he missed. So the tramp ran off, the person took his sister.
